evidenceContract.userBehavior: Explicitly request a complete reviewable AI-native project proposal, so progressive defaults must expand instead of truncating the deliverable.

observables.description: Skill receipt, configured model, formal proposal fields, capability-aware handoff, and absent execution claims.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The formal proposal covers goal, audience, value, scope, deliverables, constraints, milestones, AI capability roles, prompts, expected outputs, and acceptance without pretending execution occurred.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: A terse answer, missing handoff, fabricated budget, or false execution claim fails.

steps.prompt: $content-authoring 请输出一份完整、可评审的 AI 原生 60 秒动画 PoC 企划书。必须包含目标受众、价值、范围、交付物、关键约束、里程碑，以及图像/视频生成模型各自的角色、所需输入、可直接使用的提示词意图、预期产物和验收。没有来源内容、预算和当前工具执行结果，请明确假设与 blocked 状态，不要声称已生成。
